title: OverlaySelection
description: D87 — the overlays.json artifact: which graphics belong on which beats, decided in a call where that is the only question. Produced by the select_overlays stage (faceless_v3 only), consumed by the compiler, which prefers it when present and reads beat.overlay exactly as before when it is absent. A beat sheet is not rewritten by this file; the selection references beats by id.

selections.description: One per beat that gets a graphic. May be empty: a script with no moment worth decorating is a legitimate answer, and an empty array says so out loud where a missing file would not.

declined.description: Beats that COULD have carried a graphic and did not, with the reason. Optional, and not read by the compiler. It exists so a refusal is a recorded decision rather than an absence — which is the only way to tell restraint from an oversight when a score moves.

component.description: MUST exist in the catalog and be inside the channel's allowed_components

role.description: D86. `anchor` carries a fact and must name an anchor_ref; `emphasis` lifts a moment with pure text. A component whose catalog anchor_types are empty is emphasis whatever this says.

anchor_ref.description: index into the referenced beat's anchors; required for a fact-carrying component

props_hint.description: partial props; the compiler fills the rest from the anchor and the theme

why.description: one line, unscored, and the field that makes a later disagreement legible
